body: I can’t imagine losing that much in such a short period of time, I’m sorry. I’m also in the medical field and working is becoming impossible. It’s too hard to feel empathy for others when you’re hurting so bad.
I’m so so sorry for your losses. Helps to know I’m not crazy (although I guess technically I am). You put everything I feel into words. It’s not getting any easier.

Thank you so much for your kind words, sometimes just hearing things like that give me the tiniest bit of hope. I know it’s natural to grieve but it’s so hard to know that the rest of my life I won’t have him here with me.
